UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the application, storing supplementary information beyond basic authentication.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. (Primary Key)

displayName.description: The user's display name or full name.

photoURL.description: The Base64 encoded profile photo or URL.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Transcript.title: Transcript
Transcript.description: Stores the content of a meeting transcript submitted by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transcript entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who submitted this transcript.

title.description: An optional title for the meeting.

content.description: The full text content of the meeting transcript.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the transcript was submitted.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents an action item extracted from a meeting transcript.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this task.

transcriptId.description: Reference to the Transcript from which this task was extracted.

description.description: A clear description of the action item.

owner.description: The person assigned to complete the task.

deadline.description: The specified deadline for the task.

confidenceScore.description: The AI model's confidence in the extraction (0-100).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

definition.description: Stores meeting transcripts for a user.
Stores tasks extracted for a user.
